::: {.hero-intro}

I am an incoming Assistant Professor of Behavioral Science at **Duke Kunshan University**.

My research asks how people value outcomes that are delayed, uncertain, or both, \
and how those valuations shift with age, income, and individual circumstance across the adult lifespan.

:::
